name: thaaw-browser
description: THAAW — Open-Source Security-First Web Browser. Stop What Shouldn't Pass.

scripts.copy-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('browser/ui', 'dist/browser/ui', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('browser/internal-pages', 'dist/browser/internal-pages', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('browser/profiles', 'dist/browser/profiles', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('assets', 'dist/assets', {recursive:true});"

author: The THAAW Browser Authors
